head: df41c736268b49c3dfc34967f39baf9c6f50e168
decision: The new begin_collection branch acknowledges only an expired read belonging to the exact current process with a positively captured, absent child. It delegates failure acknowledgement to unchanged finish_collection and does not weaken recover_collection. The ordinary final collection_lock and active lease check remain the only new-attempt admission path.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: Live foreign owner or same PID with foreign process instance
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Current PID/start/boot/namespace fields and PROCESS_INSTANCE must all match. Otherwise unchanged dead-owner recovery refuses live/unverifiable owner.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: No child, spawn window, child alive/zombie, missing or foreign child identity
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Explicit dict child and running/reaped state are required before unchanged child_is_terminal validates kernel absence. none/launching cannot enter; unknown/live/zombie proof is false.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: One grace clock expires but the other does not
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Both UTC age > READ_SECONDS+REAP_SECONDS and monotonic > ticket deadline+REAP_SECONDS are required. No deadline rewrite or owner substitution.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: Stale observation races late finish or a new ticket
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Unchanged finish CAS matches active attempt plus immutable captured ticket and rechecks child terminal status under lock. Final begin obtains collection_lock again and refuses any current lease or active mutation.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: Failure acknowledgement still cannot acquire SQLite writer
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Unchanged finish keeps lease after failed acknowledgement; refreshed state leads to unchanged recover_collection live-owner refusal. New test receipt_busy exercises this path with actual SQLite writer.

reviewed_failure_scenarios.scenario: Old snapshot or child callback arrives after replacement
reviewed_failure_scenarios.result: Existing attempt/ticket fencing is unchanged; new positive regression asserts late snapshot neither releases fresh lease nor creates events/alerts. Existing collection_child remains attempt/owner/instance-fenced.
New path first requires no target.active_operation. Unchanged finish/begin and mutation claim checks remain; active_write negative preserves the unknown operation identifier.

test_evidence.reviewer_execution: Static AST, file hashing and git diff --check only; no runtime test rerun.

authentic_red.result: Second begin fails with collection_busy_or_maintenance after real writer blocks reaped callback and both finish attempts; captured child actually waited absent and owner alive. Initial fixture/environment failure is not relied on.

test_evidence.focused_supplied: 177 passed in 110.58s; terminal focused.txt read during review. Runtime execution belongs to builder/root, not reviewer.
